Ava: Heads-up — Portland LLM Mixer is 2026-06-14. We need booth + two microtalk slots confirmed. Can marketing ops confirm swag counts and speaker confirmations?

Diego: I submitted the speaker forms for Ember + Redwood demo. Priya getting copy for bench narrative.

Priya: Confirmed speaker slots for 11:20 & 14:00. I’ll draft talk blurb by Wed.

Sam: Swag update: stickers 800, pins 150, hoodies 30. Ordered from PrintCo. ETA 6/10 :truck: 

Lina: Shipping: PrintCo says 6/9 pickup, arrives 6/11. Ops needs packing list by 6/8.

Ava: Volunteer shifts? Need 3 ppl per shift 10-1, 1-4. Raj? Sam?

Raj: I can do 10-1. Sam can do 1-4.

Sam: yep 1-4 works. Also need tablet for lead capture + charger.

Priya: Lead routing — created sheet + Zap to Salesforce. Link: https://bit.ly/portland-leads

Diego: AV needs: projector + mics for two talks. Event said they provide one handheld and a room HDMI. Recommending we bring USB-C adapter and dongles.

Lina: Packing list (working): ```Stickers x800, Pins x150, Hoodies x30, Table banner, Tablet, Charger, Business cards 500, Pop-up backdrop``` add anything?

Ava: Add printed benchmark one-page (50 copies) and demo dongles.

Priya: I'll iterate on the launch post + benchmark summary. Copy to review Thu.

Sam: Can someone confirm pickup from warehouse? Ops team lead is @Maya.

Lina: @Maya can you confirm pickup window 6/9? :pleading_face: 

Maya: (Ops) Confirmed pickup 6/9 9am. Will send driver details.

Ava: Great — last thing: swag budget overage? Finance ok with +$350 for rush shipping?

Diego: We have $400 buffer. :thumbsup: 

Ava: Perfect. I'll update the shared checklist. Thanks everyone :tada:
